configurePresets.name: native
configurePresets.displayName: Windows native (Ninja Multi-Config, MSVC 14.44 pin, CUDA 13.0)
configurePresets.description: MUST be invoked inside 'vcvarsall.bat x64 -vcvars_ver=14.44'. VS 18's default MSVC toolset (14.51.36231+) crashes CUDA 13.0's cudafe++ with an ACCESS_VIOLATION on every .cu file; the side-by-side 14.44.35207 toolset is the CUDA-supported one. MSBuild-generator pin routes (-T version=..., CMAKE_VS_GLOBALS VCToolsVersion) fail under the 'Visual Studio 18 2026' generator (TRK0005 / invalid version spec), so the pin lives in the environment: use engine\build_native.bat, which locates VS via vswhere, enters vcvars 14.44, verifies VCToolsVersion, and then drives these presets. No cacheVariables are needed: the CMakeLists native defaults (FTD_ENABLE_CUDA=ON, FTD_ENABLE_PCH=ON, FTD_BUILD_EXPERIMENTAL=ON, FTD_BUILD_TEST_RUNNER=AUTO) reproduce the canonical engine/build cache.
